2016 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 3LZ with the Z07 Performance Package, 8-speed paddle-shift automatic transmission, and only about 24,000 miles. Finished in Black over Jet Black leather with suede microfiber inserts, this Z06 had an original MSRP of $104,460 and was very heavily optioned from the factory.
At the heart of the Z06 is the supercharged 6.2L LT4 V8, factory rated at 650 horsepower and 650 lb-ft of torque.

This Corvette goes well beyond stock. We have receipts documenting more than $9,300 in professional performance work completed by SS LSX Tuning and Performance in Concord, NC.

Upgrades include a BTR Stage 2 blower camshaft, BTR .660 lift platinum valve springs with titanium retainers, chromoly pushrods, DOD/AFM delete with Morel lifters, cam phaser lockout, Kooks 2 inch long-tube headers with X-pipe, NGK spark plugs, custom engine tuning, transmission tuning, and a later supercharger pulley upgrade using a Griptec 2.3 pulley with Gates HD belt and additional tuning. The documented performance work totals approximately $9,396.74.

The factory Z07 Performance Package adds serious track-focused hardware including carbon ceramic brakes, Magnetic Selective Ride Control, Michelin Pilot Super Sport Cup 2 tires when originally equipped, and Z07 suspension tuning. This Corvette also features the 3LZ Preferred Equipment Group, Carbon Flash Painted Ground Effects Package, chrome Z06 wheels, heated and ventilated seats, perforated Nappa leather seating surfaces, suede microfiber interior trim, power seat adjustments, GT bucket seats, and much more.

This is not a lightly modified Z06. It is a highly optioned, professionally upgraded example with documented performance work, exceptionally low mileage for the year, and a factory build that was already over $104,000 when new. If you are looking for a C7 Z06 with the right factory packages and meaningful performance upgrades already completed, this one deserves a closer look.

2026 BMW X5 M60i White Metallic AWD 4.4L V8 DOHC 32V Twin Turbocharged
Recent Arrival!

All-wheel drive adds year-round confidence, while advanced safety tech includes forward collision warning, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, blind spot monitoring, and collision mitigation braking.
Navigation with a touchscreen and voice control helps make trips easier, and the backup camera adds a clearer view when reversing.
Heated and cooled front seats help keep you comfortable in changing weather, with climate-controlled seating and power front seats.
The dual panoramic sunroof and power sunroof bring in more light and open-air feel for both front and rear passengers.
Rear park assist with Park Distance Control helps take stress out of parking in tighter spaces.
SiriusXM radio, Apple CarPlay, Android compatibility, and harman/kardon premium audio give you multiple ways to enjoy your music and media.
Factory remaining warranty includes 4-year/50,000-mile basic coverage and 4-year/unlimited-mile roadside assistance, plus 12-year/unlimited-mile anti-corrosion coverage.
Dynamic cruise control helps make longer drives more relaxed and easier to manage.
Front bucket seats include power adjustment, 4-way power lumbar support, adjustable thigh support, and memory settings.
Dual-zone automatic climate control lets driver and passenger set their own comfort levels.
Rear 40/20/40 split-folding seats add flexibility for passengers and cargo.
Rain-sensing wipers automatically respond to changing weather for added convenience.
20-inch alloy wheels add a clean look and pair with the sport differential for a more connected drive feel.
Hill Descent Control helps maintain control on steeper grades.
This SUV seats 5 and offers 33.9 cu ft of cargo space behind the rear seats.
Powered by a 4.4L V8 gas engine with an 8-speed automatic transmission.

Porsche Fort Collins is delighted to showcase this Certified Pre-Owned 2020 Porsche Cayenne Coupe. Finished in elegant Dolomite Silver Metallic over a Standard Black Interior, and with just 42,626 miles to its name, this Cayenne Coupe perfectly blends Porsche sports car DNA with SUV versatility and unmistakable coupe-inspired styling.


Its sleek exterior is enhanced by striking 21-inch Cayenne Exclusive Design Wheels with wheel arch extensions in exterior color, while LED Headlights with Porsche Dynamic Light System (PDLS) provide exceptional visibility. The Premium Package, Lane Change Assist, and Comfort Access further elevate everyday convenience and sophistication, giving this Cayenne Coupe an unmistakably premium presence.


Inside, the refined Black Interior offers a luxurious and driver-focused environment. The Premium Package includes 14-way Power Seats with Memory Package, Heated Front Seats, BOSE® Surround Sound System, Ambient Lighting, Auto-Dimming Mirrors, and Comfort Access. Rear Comfort Seats (2+1) provide additional passenger versatility, while the Heated Steering Wheel enhances comfort during colder months.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this Cayenne Coupe is a 3.0-liter turbocharged V6 engine, producing 335 horsepower and 332 lb-ft of torque. Paired with an 8-speed Tiptronic S automatic transmission and Porsche Active All-Wheel Drive, it delivers smooth, confident acceleration, dynamic handling, and the engaging driving experience expected from every Porsche.

Key Features:

Premium Package: Includes Ambient Lighting, Heated Front Seats, 14-way Power Seats with Memory, BOSE® Surround Sound, Comfort Access, and Auto-Dimming Mirrors.

21-Inch Cayenne Exclusive Design Wheels: Enhance the vehicle's athletic appearance while complementing its coupe-inspired profile.

LED Headlights with PDLS: Deliver outstanding nighttime visibility with adaptive lighting technology.

Lane Change Assist (LCA): Provides added confidence by monitoring adjacent lanes during highway driving.

Rear Comfort Seats (2+1): Offer additional versatility and passenger comfort for everyday usability.

BOSE® Surround Sound System: Delivers rich, immersive audio quality throughout the cabin.

This Certified Pre-Owned 2020 Porsche Cayenne Coupe offers the perfect balance of luxury, performance, and practicality, making it an exceptional choice for drivers seeking Porsche excitement with everyday versatility. Available at Porsche Fort Collins, this remarkable SUV is ready for its next adventure.

Allow us to also help arrange transportation of your new car directly to your home anywhere in the world. Trade-in proposals are always welcome. description:
This 2001 Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet has been in one family since it was special-ordered new my father configured it from the factory, and I inherited it from him. It has never been sold, traded, or passed through a dealer's used lot. That single-family ownership is why it has just 22,350 original miles and full documented service history, something you almost never find on a 25-year-old 911.

It was ordered with the factory Aero Kit, the factory hardtop (with the correct Porsche storage stand), carbon fiber interior trim, and the Traffic Pro navigation system. The original Porsche window sticker is included, showing every factory option and the as-ordered MSRP real, verifiable documentation most sellers simply don't have.

In full honesty: there's a small leak where the seal between the rear window and the soft top (black) has worn, not a tear in the top fabric itself, so it's a straightforward and inexpensive repair compared to a torn top. Not yet repaired, and the car is priced accordingly. Everything else paint, leather, mechanicals is in excellent condition consistent with the low mileage and careful care.

Beyond the car, the sale includes a few unique extras: the correct Porsche hardtop stand (the OEM rolling storage cart with locking wheels for safely storing the hardtop off the car), a genuine Porsche crest emblem, a Porsche crest display piece engraved with this car's VIN, and a collectible Porsche Motorsport teddy bear in a miniature race suit small details that reflect how much this car has been loved as more than just a vehicle.

Tiptronic automatic, Lapis Blue Metallic over Graphite Grey leather, located in St. Petersburg, FL. A genuinely documented, single-family 996 Cabriolet with real history behind it.

2008 Acura MDX that has been a terrific and dependable vehicle for our family. We originally purchased this MDX for our daughter to drive while she was in college at UT, and she has now graduated, started her career, and purchased a new car, so it's time for the Acura to find a new home.

This is a very solid, comfortable, and well-equipped SUV that still has a lot to offer. Acura built the MDX as a luxury SUV, and it shows in the number of features included. It has heated leather seats, power/electric front seats, a power sunroof, plenty of interior space, 3rd row seating, and a comfortable ride that makes it great for commuting, road trips, or as a first vehicle for a student.

We also upgraded the stereo with a newer Apple CarPlay system, which is a huge improvement over the original factory setup and makes it easy to use your phone for navigation, music, calls, podcasts, and more. The factory installed backup camera was preserved during the upgrade as well.

The interior has held up extremely well for its age. There are no rips or tears in the interior. The leather seats do show some normal wear from use, which can be seen in the pictures, but overall the cabin is clean and in very good condition. It also comes with WeatherTech interior floor mats that have helped keep the carpeting protected.

The exterior presents well for a 2008 vehicle. There are a couple of dents and normal cosmetic imperfections, all of which are shown in the photos. We've tried to represent the vehicle accurately so there are no surprises.

It also comes with TWO key fobs, which is a nice bonus and can be expensive to replace on an Acura.

If you're looking for a well-built, comfortable luxury SUV without spending a fortune, this MDX is definitely worth a look. It has served our daughter extremely well through college and has been a very sound vehicle for us. We simply no longer need it now that she has moved on to a new car.

This 1994 Chevrolet C/K 1500 Series Long Bed Regular Cab belongs to the GMT400 generation of Chevrolet pickups and reflects the straightforward truck design of its era. It uses a long bed with a regular cab body, a combination that gives the truck a practical cargo area without adding rear seating. The exterior design is square and functional, with broad surfaces, simple lines, and a nose that sits low and horizontal. This generation was built with conventional steel bodywork and an emphasis on durability rather than ornament. The proportions are familiar to anyone who knows full-size pickups from the 1990s, with a cab set ahead of a long rear box and a stance that keeps the truck easy to place in everyday use.

This model was offered with rear-wheel drive or four-wheel drive, depending on equipment, and it was built around a traditional body-on-frame chassis. Chevrolet paired the C/K 1500 with independent front suspension and a solid rear axle, using a layout that was common for light-duty trucks of the period. Powertrain choices for 1994 included gasoline V6 and V8 engines, and buyers could specify manual or automatic transmissions depending on trim and drivetrain. The 1500 designation places it in the half-ton class, which was Chevrolet's light-duty pickup line below the heavier 2500 and 3500 models. This truck was intended for everyday hauling, towing within its class, and general work use, with components selected to match that role.

This long bed provides a larger cargo floor than the short-bed version, and the regular cab keeps the interior area focused on the front seating position. Inside, the cab is arranged for basic pickup use, with a straightforward dashboard and controls that reflect early-1990s Chevrolet design. Depending on how this example was equipped, the truck could have been fitted with vinyl or cloth seating, manual or power-operated accessories, and air conditioning. Chevrolet also offered a range of convenience and comfort items across the lineup, though individual equipment varied by trim and option selection. The interior dimensions are compact compared with later full-size trucks, but the cab still provides a simple and usable environment with a direct driving position.

This 1994 Chevrolet C/K 1500 Series Long Bed Regular Cab uses the familiar pickup hardware of its time, including a front-mounted engine, steering assisted by the truck's front suspension geometry, and braking components sized for light-duty service. The long wheelbase associated with the extended cargo box contributes to a stable feel on the road, and the chassis architecture was common across Chevrolet's full-size truck range in the early 1990s. This generation of C/K trucks remained in production with only incremental changes for several model years, which is one reason parts availability and service familiarity have stayed strong. The vehicle's appeal comes from that basic specification and the way Chevrolet executed it, with a plain exterior, a useful bed, and mechanical choices that were widely understood by owners and technicians alike.

====== 2025 Ford Bronco Badlands: Built for Uncompromising Off-Road Adventure ======

Ready to tackle challenging terrain and elevate every daily drive? The 2025 Ford Bronco Badlands combines serious mechanical engineering with modern cabin comfort, making it the ideal rig for adventure seekers across Kingfisher who demand true off-road capability without sacrificing modern convenience. Finished in sleek Shadow Black with a Carbonized Gray Molded-In-Color Hard Top, this factory certified 4-door SUV commands attention whether navigating city streets or heading out beyond the pavement. Drivers looking for authentic adventure can explore our new Ford Bronco lineup to see how this iconic vehicle blends legendary utility with refined design.

===== Performance & Capability =====

Under the hood, the 2025 Ford Bronco Badlands features an EcoBoost 2.7L V-6 port/direct injection, DOHC, Ti-VCT variable valve control, twin turbo, regular unleaded, engine with 315HP, paired seamlessly with a smooth-shifting *10-Speed Automatic* transmission and robust *Four Wheel Drive*. Built for maximum off-road articulation and control, this model is equipped with the *HOSS 2.0 off-road ride suspension* featuring *Bilstein remote reservoir shock absorbers*, a *front anti-roll bar disconnect*, and *driver selectable front and rear locking differentials*. An advanced *Terrain Management System* with selectable G.O.A.T. modes lets you adapt instantly to changing ground conditions, while a *4.7 Axle Ratio* and *6 underbody skid plates* protect vital components during rugged excursions. Rated at 17 MPG city and 18 MPG highway, it balances trail-ready muscle with everyday usability. Additionally, the included *Trailer Tow Package* featuring a Class III trailer hitch and sway control expands your hauling capability for recreational gear.

===== Technology & Connectivity =====
